entry.content:
The Valhalla Spider is Aston Martin's first mid-engined open-cockpit supercar and the fastest Aston Martin ever built without a fixed roof, reaching 217 mph with the cockpit open or the optional carbon fiber hardtop in place. A twin-turbo V8 and three electric motors make a combined 1,064 horsepower, with two of the motors driving the front wheels. In Race mode, an active rear wing rises 10 inches and also works as an airbrake when you brake hard. With the roof off, a wind deflector clips in, and when the roof goes back on, the deflector folds into three pieces that stow in compartments in the door sills. The carbon fiber doors swing upward, and a new touring seat makes it easier to climb in with the roof on, though the Valhalla coupe's carbon race seat is a no-cost option. Deliveries begin in the third quarter of 2027.

Two decades of maturation and a historic partnership with Spanish sherry producer Valdespino distinguish The Macallan TIME : SPACE Sherry Cask. The 20-year-old single malt begins its journey in sherry-seasoned oak casks before undergoing a second marrying period in casks seasoned with The Macallan's own Valdespino sherry. This dual-stage approach marks a new chapter in the distillery's longstanding relationship with Spanish oak and sherry craftsmanship.
